title: Are you struggling with high diesel and gas prices? Share your story | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

Stubbornly high diesel and gas prices are burning a hole in many Americans’ wallets, forcing some to cut back on their spending or make more drastic changes.

Although Trump administration officials promised that the spike in fuel prices would subside, the cost remains far higher than it was when the US-Iran conflict began in late February.

Are near-record high diesel prices affecting you or your business? Are you taking additional steps to curtail your spending as diesel and gasprices remain elevated? Tell us more using the form below. You could be included in a future CNN story.
